greeting: Resistance Leader Sovereign on comms. Stage 1: The Golden Cage. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Fallen Crown. Objective drift gets teams buried.
The walls keep whispering patch notes. I only trust the ones with timestamps.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Infiltrate the Capital's lower districts.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Infiltrate the Capital's lower districts; Make contact with the Fallen Crown; Avoid Void patrols. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Infiltrate the Capital and contact the resistance. Immediate move: Infiltrate the Capital's lower districts.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 1 resolved: The Golden Cage. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Shadows in the Palace.
rumor: Crown district scribes whisper that decrees are being signed by people long dead.
People keep repeating one clue from The Golden Cage: 'Avoid Void patrols'.
I put fear on a schedule. It keeps missing meetings.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn gives the cleanest sightlines in the capital ruins. Move before crowds regroup.
dialog.time_noon: Noon is surveillance peak. Assume every lane is observed.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk favors ambush teams and rumor storms. Confirm every briefing twice.
dialog.time_night: Night in the crown district means quiet knives and loud mistakes. Stay disciplined.

party_reactions.kade: Resistance Leader Sovereign sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Resistance Leader Sovereign accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Resistance Leader Sovereign talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: If the world bends, we bend it back together.
